defaultUse: Approved read-only clean-room study. Extract behavior, interfaces, inputs, outputs, invariants, and tests into a source-free functional specification; implement original Airship code from that specification only.

repositories.name: Hermes Agent
areas: agent loop and stable prompt/session identity
profiles, sessions, resume, and context compression
skills, skill installation, slash commands, and tools
memory provenance and live capability awareness

repositories.name: sirouk/claw-code
repositories.originRelationship: The named sirouk fork is pinned at this revision but its Git transport returned HTTP 403 during capture. The same commit is reachable from its public parent, ultraworkers/claw-code, which is used only to hydrate the fork revision. The fork revision itself has no license file; the parent's later MIT license is not assumed to apply retroactively.
repositories.provenanceWarning: The project describes a clean-room rewrite informed by an exposed proprietary Claude Code sourcemap. Do not copy source, prompts, text, tests, structures, or assets.

repositories.name: sirouk/claude-code-rs
repositories.originRelationship: Fork of Kuberwastaken/claurst. The fork revision has no license file; the parent's current GPL-3.0 license is recorded for context but is not assumed to license this fork revision.
repositories.provenanceWarning: The project describes a Rust clean-room implementation from specifications produced after examining an exposed proprietary Claude Code sourcemap. Do not copy source, prompts, text, tests, structures, or assets.

repositories.name: OpenAI Codex
repositories.originRelationship: Official OpenAI upstream. The repository license does not license proprietary models or services.
areas: tools, shell, workspace, and codebase instructions
model control, sessions, resume, and task presentation
lightweight composer and in-flight agent interaction

repositories.name: Visual Studio Code / Code - OSS
repositories.originRelationship: Official Code - OSS source upstream. This is distinct from Microsoft's branded Visual Studio Code distribution and product license.
areas: Explorer tree, filtering, file icons, and drag and drop
source-control tree, staging, history, and diff tabs
themes, keyboard behavior, layout, and accessibility

repositories.name: Open WebUI
repositories.originRelationship: Canonical Open WebUI upstream. The pinned custom license includes branding restrictions; historical files can carry earlier terms described by its LICENSE_HISTORY.
areas: thread list, search, favorites, branching, and resume
composer, attachments, message actions, and queued prompts
reasoning, tools, citations, and progressive disclosure
responsive chat behavior and mobile parity

repositories.name: MinIO
repositories.originRelationship: Canonical MinIO repository, archived and described upstream as no longer maintained at capture time.
areas: object lifecycle, CORS, health, and failure behavior
encrypted profile and workspace persistence integration

repositories.name: CocoIndex
areas: memory recall, graph, and index support

repositories.name: isomorphic-git

areas: browser-native Git objects, refs, index, and worktrees

repositories.name: xterm.js
repositories.originRelationship: Canonical xterm.js upstream and the source project for Airship's pinned terminal-renderer dependency.

notCloned.name: ChatGPT
notCloned.reason: Proprietary product and UI; no canonical open-source application repository. Behavioral observation only.

notCloned.name: Claude and official Claude Code
notCloned.reason: The official public repository carries Anthropic commercial terms and does not expose the core implementation. Behavioral observation only; the two approved public third-party studies above remain subject to the absolute clean-room/no-copy boundary.

notCloned.name: Cursor
notCloned.reason: Proprietary product; its public repository does not contain the product source. CocoIndex supplies a legitimate open-source incremental-indexing study instead.

notCloned.name: Platform and provider technologies
notCloned.reason: WebGPU, WebNN, WebAssembly, OPFS, TDX, SEV, NVIDIA Confidential Computing, Chutes, Google Drive, GitHub, and S3 are standards, hardware, or service targets rather than cloneable product-source references.

notCloned.name: Incidental runtimes and tools
notCloned.reason: Git, Bash, Linux, Python, Node.js, Docker, and Moby were capability or deployment references. Mirroring their large source trees would not improve this focused Airship design library.
